metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 1971 · Fiddler on the Roof
metas.description: In pre-revolutionary Russia, a Jewish peasant with traditional values contends with marrying off three of his daughters with modern romantic ideals while growing anti-Semitic sentiment threatens his village.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1971 · Willy Wonka & the Chocolate Factory
metas.description: A poor but hopeful boy seeks one of the five coveted golden tickets that will send him on a tour of Willy Wonka's mysterious chocolate factory.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 1979 · The Muppet Movie
metas.description: Kermit and his newfound friends trek across America to find success in Hollywood, but a frog legs merchant is after Kermit.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 1977 · The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
metas.description: In this collection of animated shorts based on the stories and characters by A.A. Milne, Winnie the Pooh, a honey-loving teddy bear, embarks on some eccentric adventures.

metas.name: ★ 7.3 · 1976 · The Bad News Bears
metas.description: An aging, down-on-his-luck ex-minor leaguer coaches a team of misfits in an ultra-competitive California little league.
